title: chi
notes: chi's router on net/http with no middleware. Pages and JSON are the standard library's, as chi is only a router.
details: chi's router on net/http, with no middleware (a new chi router has none). chi is a router and nothing else: the pages are Go's html/template (which does the escaping) and the API is encoding/json, written to the response as chi's own examples do, so this differs from the net/http entry only in the router. One process on the default Go scheduler (GOMAXPROCS is every core), built with go build and no flags beyond -mod=readonly. Go has no build-time prerendering, so /about is a template with no data, rendered on each request like the item page; the templates are parsed once when the server starts. No request logging.
